title: Shill Farm
tagline: Browser-based game the allows players to take curated trips via cow produced mushrooms.
description: Shill Farm is a hyper-casual game that allows players to interact in a number of ways. First, visit our browser-based farm and feed virtual cows created using the Ethereum and Polygon blockchains. Our cows produced the best mushrooms in Web3, just take one for yourself and see! If you enjoy your trip you can join the Cow DAO by buying $BULLISH tokens and curate mushroom trips for others. Cow DAO membership comes with governance privileges of the DAO's treasury. The treasury will stream a portion of the proceeds from the $BULLISH launch to the Woodlawn United nonprofit, a Yearn Finance vault, and Team W3BBIE using SuperFluid.
how_its_made: The game's front end was made using Phaser3.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js. Our world-famous cows were minted on the Polygon which was a great blockchain for that portion of the project because it makes the cows easy to transfer to our top three bidders from the Cow DAO PartyBid. A successful Cow DAO PartyBid will create an erc20 token ($BULLISH) that can be wrapped into a SuperToken using Superfluid to stream to members for DAO participation in the future.
